name: agora-roundtable
description: Turn any public figure into your personal coach, living or historical. /coach <name> researches the person and talks to you as them. /roundtable <name1>, <name2>, ... runs multiple coaches simultaneously. /roundtable <preset-name> loads a named preset. /roundtable-save <name> saves a preset. /coach-update <name> syncs inbox material into a coach's research.
